entry.title: David M. Prouty Sworn in for Second Term as Board Member
entry.summary:
August 25, 2026
WASHINGTON —On August 25, 2026, David M. Prouty was sworn in for his second term as a Member of the National Labor Relations Board. Member Prouty’s second term will commence on August 28, 2026.Member Prouty, of Maryland, was nominated by President Donald J. Trump to serve a second five-year term expiring on August 27, 2031. entry.title: Fred B. Jacob Appointed Chief Counsel to Board Member David M. Prouty
entry.summary:
August 27, 2026
David M. Prouty, Member of the National Labor Relations Board, announced today the appointment of Fred B. Jacob as his Chief Counsel. Member Prouty will begin his second five-year term as a Board Member on August 28, 2026.  Mr. Jacob replaces David I. Goldman, who is returning to his prior position as an NLRB Administrative Law Judge. entry.title: NLRB Appoints Five New Administrative Law Judges
entry.summary:
September 08, 2026
The National Labor Relations Board (NLRB) has appointed five new Administrative Law Judges (ALJs): David Goldman, Lisa Dunn, Stephanie Cotilla Eitzen, Zuzana Murarova, and Steven Wyllie.  They were chosen after a rigorous vetting process.
